title: Rate and numbers call: Jordan Pike
transcript:
Renata: Jordan, it's Renata. Thanks for picking up.
Jordan: Hey Renata. I saw your email, so what did the underwriter say?
Renata: You're approved up to three hundred ten thousand dollars.
Jordan: Nice. That's right where I hoped to be.
Renata: And the payment on that, with taxes and insurance, comes to around twenty six fifty a month.
Jordan: I can live with twenty six fifty. My lease is up in the spring, so the timing works.
Renata: Good. The program you're looking at has a few options on the down payment side, so we'll figure out what you need to bring, it depends on the program.
Jordan: Right, I've heard different things. Some people say very little down, other people say you need a lot.
Renata: Both are true, depending on the program and on what the seller agrees to cover. I don't want to guess out loud and have you plan around the wrong thing.
Jordan: Fair enough. So roughly what would closing look like?
Renata: I'll run it and get back to you.
Jordan: Okay. No rush, I'm just trying to picture it.
Renata: Totally reasonable. Have you decided between the townhouse and the single family?
Jordan: Leaning townhouse. Lower upkeep, and I travel a lot.
Renata: That helps, because the association dues change the picture a little. Send me the listing when you can, so I can build the numbers around the real house.
Jordan: I'll forward it tonight.
Renata: Perfect. Once I've run everything, I'll text you tomorrow with the numbers.
Jordan: Sounds good. Thanks, Renata.
Renata: Anytime.
